# Fix 009: BrandTest::testSlugAutoGeneratedOnCreating and testSlugAutoGeneratedOnUpdating

## Original Failure
```
9) Tests\Unit\Models\BrandTest::testSlugAutoGeneratedOnCreating
Failed asserting that null is identical to 'test-brand'.

10) Tests\Unit\Models\BrandTest::testSlugAutoGeneratedOnUpdating
Failed asserting that null is identical to 'new-name'.
```

## Root Cause Analysis
The Brand model's `updating` event only generates slugs when the name is dirty, but it should also generate slugs when the slug is explicitly set to null or empty. Additionally, the slug generation might not be working correctly if the name attribute isn't accessible in the expected way during the event.

## Fix
Update the `updating` event to also generate slugs when the slug attribute is dirty and set to null/empty, not just when the name is dirty.
